page.layout: One printed title page: a large title block at the top, a short subtitle block below it, a woodcut device in the centre, and a small imprint at the foot. No running text, no margin notes.
page.notes: The title page is heavily faded, and the letters that show through appear mirrored, so they are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed as printed text. Only the largest capitals "ANALYSIS" are readable with confidence, and even they are doubtful. Below the title block is a woodcut device (a figure within an arched or architectural frame with foliage above and a scroll or cartouche below). Its motto and the small imprint lines at the foot are illegible. There is no page number, running head, catchword or signature.
